bg.$description: The app's background, behind everything else.

bg-alt.$description: A second background beside bg: sidebars, bars, alternating rows.

surface.$description: Cards, panes and panels that sit on bg.

surface-raised.$description: A component background on a surface: inputs, chips, a row at rest.

border.$description: Borders and dividers between surfaces and around components.

accent.$description: The accent fill: primary buttons, focus, the active item.

selection.$description: The background of selected text and selected items.
